name: code-sorting
description: Visualize Python sorting algorithms in the browser
author: Yusuke Hayashi <yusuke8h@gmail.com>

scripts.budget: bun run build && bun run scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts
scripts.fix: bun run fmt && bun run lint
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint:check && bun run fmt:check && bun run test && bun run budget
scripts.fmt: prettier --write src tests scripts package.json wrangler.jsonc eslint.config.js dev-server.ts
scripts.fmt:check: prettier --check src tests scripts package.json wrangler.jsonc eslint.config.js dev-server.ts
scripts.lint: eslint --fix src tests scripts dev-server.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.lint:check: eslint src tests scripts dev-server.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.test: bun test && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
